agyos_skill.intent: Post-process AI-generated text through the unslop CLI to strip AI writing patterns before publishing
agyos_skill.instructions: unslop is a CLI tool that post-processes text to remove AI writing patterns programmatically. Unlike skills that ask the agent to avoid AI-isms, unslop runs as a deterministic pipeline step: pipe text in, get clean text out. Use it as a final pass before committing docs, publishing posts, or sending any AI-generated content to production. The `--deterministic` flag makes output reproducible — same input always produces same output. The `--stdin` flag reads from stdin, enabling shell pipeline composition. - When you have AI-generated text ready to publish and want a final cleanup pass - When working in a shell pipeline where text quality needs to be enforced automatically - When writing commit hooks or CI steps that validate content before it ships - When you need reproducible text normalization across multiple runs Install once: ```bash pipx install unslop uv tool install unslop ``` Verify: ```bash unslop --version ``` Standard cleanup (may vary slightly between runs): ```bash echo "This leverages cutting-edge AI to deliver robust solutions." | unslop --stdin ``` Deterministic cleanup (same input → same output every run): ```bash echo "This leverages cutting-edge AI to deliver robust solutions." | unslop --stdin --deterministic ``` Pipe the output of any command through unslop: ```bash
